data.title: Land secured for South Auckland hospital
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Land has been secured for a future hospital facility on Karaka Road in Drury, marking a significant investment in the long-term healthcare needs of South Auckland's growing population.

128385.label: Land secured for South Auckland hospital

data.title: Pharmacies to provide more funded medicines
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Pharmac and Health New Zealand are increasing the number of funded medicines community pharmacies can provide from today, Associate Health Minister David Seymour and Health Minister Simeon Brown say.

128384.label: Pharmacies to provide more funded medicines

data.title: Government progresses plan changes to enable growth for New Plymouth
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Targeted changes to New Plymouth’s District Plan will make it easier for homeowners and developers to build, alter homes, and make better use of land, while removing unnecessary consenting requirements and other planning barriers to growth.

128383.label: Government progresses plan changes to enable growth for New Plymouth

data.title: Next steps for Nelson Tasman weather radar
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Nelson Tasman communities are one step closer to more timely and accurate weather information, with a site selected for the region’s new weather radar.

128381.label: Next steps for Nelson Tasman weather radar

data.title: Beekeepers get more certainty on American foulbrood management
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: The Government is progressing long-signalled updates to the National American Foulbrood Pest Management Plan, based on proposals developed and consulted on by the beekeeping industry.

128376.label: Beekeepers get more certainty on American foulbrood management

data.title: Tasman SH60 intersection improvement underway
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: The Government is progressing important safety improvements to a key Tasman State Highway intersection, following community concern after multiple crashes.

data.title: Working capital grants for regional airlines
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: The Regional Infrastructure Fund will provide funding to help regional airlines manage the operating pressures facing the sector.

128386.label: Working capital grants for regional airlines

data.title: Dry dock project moves to expert consideration
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: The Northland Shipyard and Dry Dock project has had its Fastrack application accepted as complete by the Environmental Protection Authority.

128387.label: Dry dock project moves to expert consideration

data.title: New appointment to Māori language Commission
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Dr Julian Wilcox has been appointed Chair of the Māori Language Commission for a three-year term, effective 5 October 2026.

128389.label: New appointment to Māori language Commission

data.title: Taking $14.6 million off criminals to protect New Zealanders
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Money seized from criminals will fund nine initiatives to reduce violence, prevent reoffending, and disrupt the drug trade, says Associate Justice Minister Nicole McKee.

128390.label: Taking $14.6 million off criminals to protect New Zealanders
